what: layer 2 traceability, state audit (docs/LAYER2_TRACEABILITY.md): coverage of every layer-2 ruling in the label, per-run trace counts, event time window on main's code
database: working PostgreSQL 17 of the layer-2 session, DDL of main before PR #48 (layer-2 objects identical), pinned HF file 35b17aa9; runs are REPLAY of recorded Apertus v1.5 8B answers
suva_labels: none (aggregates and run ids only, D-031)

queries.label_coverage:
WITH lab AS (
  SELECT p.ruling_id, p.assessment_id FROM triage.v_scope_pipeline p WHERE p.step = 'layer2_judge'
), j AS (
  SELECT a.*, lj.llm_call_id, lj.prompt_version_id AS lj_prompt, lj.p_yes, lj.top_logprobs, lj.truncation,
         lj.text_chars_total, lj.text_chars_sent, lj.served_model AS lj_served
  FROM lab JOIN triage.assessment a ON a.assessment_id = lab.assessment_id
  LEFT JOIN triage.llm_judgement lj ON lj.assessment_id = a.assessment_id
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'label_rulings_layer2', (SELECT count(*) FROM lab),
  'label_rulings_layer1', (SELECT count(*) FROM triage.v_scope_pipeline WHERE step = 'layer1_filter'),
  'outcome_ok', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.outcome = 'ok'),
  'with_score_raw', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.score_raw IS NOT NULL),
  'with_explanation_de', count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce(btrim(j.explanation_de), '') <> ''),
  'with_input_text_and_fingerprint', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.input_text_id IS NOT NULL AND j.input_fingerprint IS NOT NULL),
  'with_span', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.span_id IS NOT NULL),
  'upstream_is_layer1', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM triage.assessment u WHERE u.assessment_id = j.upstream_assessment_id AND u.step = 'layer1_filter')),
  'upstream_layer1_has_ledger', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM triage.assessment_reason r WHERE r.assessment_id = j.upstream_assessment_id)),
  'version_has_decision_and_validation_ref', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.component_version cv WHERE cv.component_version_id = j.component_version_id AND cv.decision_ref IS NOT NULL AND cv.validation_ref IS NOT NULL)),
  'with_llm_judgement', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.llm_call_id IS NOT NULL),
  'call_same_run_ruling_step', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id AND c.run_id = j.run_id AND c.ruling_id = j.ruling_id AND c.step = 'layer2_judge')),
  'call_prompt_equals_judgement_prompt', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id AND c.prompt_version_id = j.lj_prompt)),
  'prompt_has_template_sha256', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.prompt_version pv WHERE pv.prompt_version_id = j.lj_prompt AND pv.template_sha256 IS NOT NULL)),
  'messages_blob_present', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c JOIN ops.blob b ON b.sha256 = c.messages_sha256 WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id)),
  'raw_output_and_cache_key', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id AND c.raw_output IS NOT NULL AND c.cache_key IS NOT NULL)),
  'served_model_recorded', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id AND coalesce(c.served_model, c.served_model_header) IS NOT NULL)),
  'served_model_allowed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c JOIN ops.model m ON m.allowed AND lower(coalesce(c.served_model, c.served_model_header)) IN (lower(m.gateway_id), lower(m.hf_id)) WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id)),
  'top_logprobs_stored', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.top_logprobs IS NOT NULL),
  'truncated', count(*) FILTER (WHERE j.text_chars_sent < j.text_chars_total),
  'cache_hit_answer', count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.llm_call_id = j.llm_call_id AND c.cache_hit)),
  'trace_view_rows', (SELECT count(DISTINCT t.ruling_id) FROM triage.v_scope_trace t JOIN lab USING (ruling_id) WHERE t.step = 'layer2_judge' AND t.llm_call_id IS NOT NULL),
  'runs_feeding_label', (SELECT json_agg(x) FROM (SELECT j2.run_id, r.status, r.mode, r.git_dirty, r.params ? 'code_sha256' AS code_hash, count(*) AS rulings FROM j j2 JOIN ops.pipeline_run r ON r.run_id = j2.run_id GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) x)
) FROM j;
queries.runs:
SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.started_at) FROM (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.started_at, r.status, r.mode, r.kind, r.git_dirty, r.model_override,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM triage.assessment a WHERE a.run_id = r.run_id AND a.step = 'layer2_judge') AS assessments,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id) AS llm_calls,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.cache_hit) AS cache_hits,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.span s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.operation = 'llm.call') AS call_spans,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.span s WHERE s.run_id = r.run_id AND s.operation = 'layer2.judge') AS judge_spans,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.llm_call c WHERE c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.span_id IS NULL) AS calls_without_span,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.log_event e WHERE e.run_id = r.run_id) AS events,
    (SELECT json_object_agg(code, n) FROM (SELECT e.event_code AS code, count(*) AS n FROM ops.log_event e WHERE e.run_id = r.run_id GROUP BY 1) ev) AS event_codes,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.run_metric m WHERE m.run_id = r.run_id) AS metrics,
    (SELECT max(m.value) FROM ops.run_metric m WHERE m.run_id = r.run_id AND m.metric_code = 'replay_misses') AS replay_misses_metric,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ops.log_event e WHERE e.run_id = r.run_id AND (e.ts < r.started_at OR e.ts > r.finished_at)) AS events_outside_run_window
  FROM ops.pipeline_run r WHERE r.run_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT run_id FROM ops.span WHERE step = 'layer2_judge')
) x;
queries.event_window_on_main_code:
SELECT json_build_object('run_id', r.run_id, 'kind', r.kind, 'git_commit', r.git_commit, 'events', count(e.*),
  'events_outside_run_window', count(e.*) FILTER (WHERE e.ts < r.started_at OR e.ts > r.finished_at))
FROM ops.pipeline_run r LEFT JOIN ops.log_event e ON e.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE r.run_id = '404d0225-c5ab-4a78-9ffc-eb72ea7f3ce6' GROUP BY r.run_id, r.kind, r.git_commit;
